title: Reference battle
description: The gas benchmark (docs/gpu-gas-plan.md): four ships firing every engine — the Mammoth, Gunship 3, Gunship 2 and the FLY lander — two explosive shells bursting on rubble asteroids within the same second, and the plumes washing over asteroids behind the ships. Q and E fly the whole fleet. Built by scripts/reference-battle.ts; the gas cost here is the baseline the GPU gas is budgeted against.

ui.lookFor: The gas benchmark: every engine on four ships fires from the start, and two shells burst on the rocks ahead within the first second. Watch the parcel count and the step time.
